  "title": "Marketing Executive",
  "description": "Managing Banex Mall Limited is a property and facility management company responsible for the administration, operation, and maintenance of Banex Mall. The company oversees the day-to-day management of the mall, ensuring a safe, clean, and conducive environment for businesses, customers, and visitors.

Its core functions include facility management, tenant relations, commercial and leasing, sales, security coordination, maintenance of common areas, revenue administration, compliance monitoring, customer service, and the overall enhancement of the mall&#39;s commercial operations. The company is committed to maintaining high operational standards, maximizing tenant satisfaction, and supporting a thriving business environment within the mall.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Marketing Executive

Job Location: Lekki / Oniru, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	Managing Banex Mall Limited is seeking a creative, proactive and results-driven Marketing Executive to support the company&#39;s marketing activities, promote its facilities and services, attract customers and generate business opportunities.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for executing marketing campaigns, managing digital content, supporting event activations, engaging prospective clients and contributing to increased mall visibility, footfall and revenue.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute marketing campaigns to promote the mall, its tenants, facilities and services.
	Create and manage content for social media platforms and other marketing channels.
	Design promotional materials, flyers, adverts and other marketing content.
	Support the marketing and promotion of event halls, available commercial spaces and mall activations.
	Identify potential customers, corporate clients, business partners and event organisers.
	Support lead generation and follow-up activities to convert prospects into customers.
	Coordinate promotional activities, exhibitions, events and other mall marketing initiatives.
	Build relationships with tenants, customers, vendors and external partners.
	Monitor market trends and competitors to identify new marketing opportunities.
	Support advertising, sponsorship and promotional partnerships.
	Track marketing campaign performance, customer engagement and leads generated.
	Prepare regular reports on marketing activities, campaign results and business opportunities.
	Work closely with the Sales, Leasing, Events and Operations teams to achieve the company&#39;s commercial objectives.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance will be assessed based on:


	Marketing campaigns executed.
	Growth in social media engagement and brand visibility.
	Qualified leads generated.
	Marketing materials and promotional content delivered.
	Support provided for venue bookings and commercial sales.
	Customer and tenant engagement.
	Events and activations successfully promoted.
	Marketing partnerships and advertising opportunities identified.
	Timeliness and quality of marketing reports.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or equivalent qualification in Marketing, Mass Communication, Business Administration or a related field.
	5-10 years of relevant marketing experience.
	Experience in digital marketing, content creation, brand promotion or sales support.
	Proficiency in social media management and digital marketing tools.
	Basic graphic design skills, preferably using Canva or similar applications.
	Good written and verbal communication skills.
	Strong interpersonal, organisational and presentation skills.
	Ability to generate ideas, execute campaigns and meet deadlines.
	Basic knowledge of marketing analytics, lead generation and campaign reporting.
	Ability to work independently and collaboratively with other departments.
	Must be proactive, creative, organised and results-oriented.


Salary
N200,000 - N250,000 monthly.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: mbmlcareers@gmail.com using &quot;Application &ndash; Marketing Executive&quot; as the subject of the email.
